title: Demo
description: Request rate, errors and latency (RED) from traces, plus logs.

variables.name: service
variables.label: Service
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
ORDER BY ServiceName

panels.title: Request rate
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS rps
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error rate
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time,
  countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() * 100 AS error_rate
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p95
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error logs
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS errors
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SeverityNumber >= 17 AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL STEP toIntervalSecond($__interval_s)

panels.title: Requests per second by service
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName, count() / $__interval_s AS rps
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

panels.title: Server latency
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p50,
  quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p95,
  quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p99
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Errors by service
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

panels.title: Log volume by severity
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, SeverityText, count() AS logs
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY time, SeverityText ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top operations
panels.sql:
SELECT ServiceName AS service, SpanName AS operation, count() AS requests,
  round(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() * 100, 2) AS error_pct,
  round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 2) AS p50_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 2) AS p95_ms
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY service, operation
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Slowest operations (p95)
panels.sql:
SELECT concat(ServiceName, ' ', SpanName) AS operation, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p95
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName IN (${service})
GROUP BY operation ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Recent warnings and errors
panels.sql:
SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, Body, TraceId
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SeverityNumber >= 13 AND ServiceName IN (${service})
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200
